why.insideTitle: At the heart of the agency

q1.question: Who are your services for?
q1.answer: Businesses of all sizes, especially small and medium businesses that want structured communication and measurable results.

q2.question: Is the advertising budget included?
q2.answer: No. For the Growth and Premium packs, the advertising budget is paid separately and added to the price of the pack. We create, manage and optimize your campaigns.

q3.question: Who produces the photos, videos and websites?
q3.answer: Our network of selected partners handles technical production under SIDEKOM's supervision. You keep a single point of contact.

q4.question: Do you organize conferences and events?
q4.answer: Yes. We take care of the design, promotion, coordination, live coverage and follow-up after the event.

q5.question: How do we get started?
q5.answer: Write to us or book a call. We make a first diagnosis of your situation, then suggest the pack or programme that suits you best.

q6.question: When are you available?
q6.answer: We work 24/7. We reply to every message as soon as possible.
